identity.evidence: README assigns Twin Pines to Rossen and maps FID 766. The bundled OSM campus dataset has named way 301934836, Twin Pines Cooperative, at the asset coordinates. The current Twin Pines contact page lists 322 Waldron Street. Purdue FSCL lists Twin Pines as an active cooperative house; Purdue's 2023 story says Twin Pines remains at 322 Waldron in the same house and same spot as the alumna's time there.
identity.facility_match: No indication of the historical Shoemaker/Twin Pines 1940 location at 103 Russell Street: the current Twin Pines facility is 322 Waldron, and Purdue's 2023 facility story confirms the persistent Waldron location.

geometry_edits: Replaced 16 m uniform prism with estimated two-storey residential walls and 9.05 m gabled roof ridge.
Added front covered porch with four round columns on brick piers, white railing, central entry and steps, matching photos.
Added lap-siding seam detail, shuttered windows, gable vent, roof eaves and a lower rear/northeast wing roof.
Preserved six source-derived ground vertices and campus object transform.
changes.height_status: estimated, not measured; no authoritative elevation or measured roof height was located
changes.floors_status: two occupied stories are visually supported; attic/upper roof volume is shown, no floor plan verified
changes.orientation_status: E-W long building axis follows the projected source footprint. Southern entrance/frontage is inferred from street/site position and the source photo viewpoints, not azimuth-surveyed.

checks: Expected collection and object, exactly one unified mesh, zero modifiers.
Zero object transforms and no campus-coordinate shift.
All six source base points match within 0.0001 m.
Estimated ridge is 9.05 m; mesh is 2,758 vertices and 1,900 polygons.

unresolved_uncertainties: No measured height or architectural drawings found; eave and ridge heights (6.45 m, 9.05 m), story spacing and roof dimensions are visual estimates.
Exact number and placement of windows on all elevations are estimated from partial photos.
The old photo has dark shutters and white siding; the current porch image has muted gray-green siding but does not show the full facade, so current full-house finish remains uncertain.

The source footprint may include covered porch/roof or generalized edge rather than a surveyed structural wall line. Porch extension is therefore represented from photo evidence and extends slightly beyond the base footprint.
No aerial/orthographic imagery was captured for this task; roof/facade plan interpretation and south-front orientation remain approximate.
